name: State of the Teutonic Order
summary: A crusader state on the Baltic, conquered from the pagan Prussians by German knights of the Teutonic Order; defeated by Poland–Lithuania at Grunwald (1410), it became the secular Duchy of Prussia in 1525.

knownFor.label: Malbork Castle
knownFor.note: Largest brick castle in the world.
